The periodic Poisson solver is proved locally because the published elliptic prerequisite covers rectangular Dirichlet problems, not periodic ones.

Owner reconciliation remains for the NA-23 interface mismatch. Run-wide checks also found unrelated blockers: a malformed YAML locator in batch 12, invalid uppercase item IDs in batch 14, and incomplete inventories or stale dependency levels in other batches. Details are in the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-analysis-remaining-71-2026-10-17-batch-61.notes.md). I left shared scheduling data and other batches unchanged.

One readiness record, for `def-periodic-pic-grid-and-inner-product`, retains a tentative blocker phrase in its reason; the notes clarify that the record succeeded and explain the actual run-wide issues. I did not overwrite it.
